_comment: Single source of truth for the progress bar in README.md (Chinese then English), README.en.md, README.zh-HK.md, README.ja.md and README.ko.md. Run `python scripts/progress.py` to recompute and rewrite the marked blocks; `python scripts/progress.py --check` fails if the READMEs are stale. A task earns its weight only at its evidence level: offline = 50%, real NinjaTrader Sim/Demo = 100%. Nothing here is prop-firm or live acceptance. Weights are the maintainer's judgement of how much each item matters for 'safe to copy to Demo / prop-firm Sim accounts', not a measured quantity.

snapshot.note: Levels were assigned by the maintainer's agent from the evidence listed per item and then deliberately lowered where a step was not re-run on the current build. Read the evidence column, not just the bar.

3.label: offline PLUS verified on real NinjaTrader Simulator / prop-firm Sim accounts (SIM TEST build)

demo.ready_when: every item with must=true is at level 3, and there is no open P0 safety defect

prop.name_en: Copy to prop-firm simulated accounts (evaluation / demo only)
prop.name_zh: 複製到 Prop Firm 模擬帳戶（僅評估／Demo）
prop.ready_when: demo target ready, plus prop-only items at level 3, plus a rule review per firm by the user (never certified by this software)

safety_gates.evidence: Basic shared-OCO safety on the integrated candidate is not accepted on real NinjaTrader. PR #22 supersedes the historical missing waiting-group implementation; synthetic tests alone do not accept provider cancellation behavior. Multi-group allocation is not silently removed from scope.

Per-account provider threads, accepted callback retention and close races remain unaccepted on real NinjaTrader for the integrated candidate. Two followers still exercise this boundary; healthy timing is not stalled-provider isolation proof.

Historical real-NT evidence is pinned to older candidates. Source d70b8a49ceeb87e2207fe5c9811203723ea7f0edae90d18ebeab334a10e210a5 has compiled and run offline suites on the VM, not completed the exact-candidate real-provider must-have matrix.

ExplicitManualFlatReconciliationAvailable still fails on the integrated candidate. Position=0, visible terminal orders or ordinary unlock do not resolve an ambiguous accepted Flatten or the attached owned ledger; no reviewed end-to-end confirmed-flat recovery path exists.

items.en: Leader to followers: entry, exit, cancel, modify; short and long
items.zh: Leader 跟單：入場、平倉、取消、改單；做多做空
items.evidence: Real NT on the current build (2026-10-13): Buy/Sell market round trips, a passive Limit copied and its cancel mirrored, exit copied to the follower that was not flattened. Only two follower accounts, only Limit and Market orders, MNQ only. StopMarket entries and a real multi-lot partial fill were not seen. Real NT 2026-10-15 (6 Tradeify sim followers): a leader Limit copied to all, price changed once and then 3 times quickly (every follower followed each Change, final price equal), cancelled -> all cancelled.

Also with a stop and target (same OCO id) still working: both cancelled, account closed, other follower unaffected. A Flat the provider rejects and a disconnect during Flat are not tested on real NT.

items.en: Flatten selected / all, with confirmation naming accounts
items.zh: 批量／全部 Flatten，確認框列出帳戶
items.evidence: Real NT 2026-10-14, source c9fbf2cb3005, 11 prop-firm sim followers: leader SL rejected by NT so its OCO TP was cancelled; followers mirrored, each locked '1 lot UNPROTECTED'. Flatten all asked once, named every account (19 incl. Sim101/Playback/Backtest/max-loss accounts), all 11 confirmed flat in 4 s, Stop then went DISARMED without an NT restart (it used to need one). Playback101/Backtest returned 'FLATTEN FAILED: Connection' (not connected) and were logged, not retried. Per-account Flat with a TP+SL working: both cancelled, flat confirmed in 3 s. Real NT 2026-10-15, source bfc8a2531acf (rival bug check, Replikanto 1.7.1.0): with a 1-lot follower position, the Flatten confirmation answered No, closed with the window X (WM_CLOSE) and dismissed with Esc left the position and orders unchanged; only Yes sent the Close (filled, flat in 3-4 s). A second Flat on an already-flat account sent nothing new to the provider.
items.ach_zh: 批量／全部 Flatten
items.ach_ja: 選択／全口座の Flatten

items.en: ATM / TP-SL exit mirroring with OCO between legs
items.zh: ATM／TP-SL 出場跟隨，兩邊 OCO
items.evidence: Real NT: leader Stop + Limit under one OCO id copied to both followers (Working), per-account Flat cancels them, and a leader MARKET exit closes the follower and cancels both once (after the market-exit fix). NOT covered on real NT: modify of price/quantity this session, a rejected stop, fractional multi-group OCO (#3), and a stop + target WITHOUT an OCO id (locks the account, open). Real NT 2026-10-15 (5 Tradeify sim followers): a lone leader stop with an OCO id is copied (was refused after a cancelled entry, fixed); leader stop moved twice -> each follower exactly 2 Changes (a Change storm of 140-350 Changes per follower was found and fixed); Stop + Limit under one OCO id: 6 Stops + 6 Limits working (leader + 5).
items.ach_zh: TP／SL 跟隨 ＋ OCO
items.ach_ja: TP／SL ミラー＋OCO

items.en: Fail-closed locks (unknown exposure, thrown Flatten, rejected stop), no auto-retry, explicit unlock

items.evidence: Real NT 2026-10-14 (11 followers): a max-loss Tradeify follower's copy was Rejected by the provider -> account locked 'Follower order rejected', exactly 1 Submit, no retry, no market fallback, the other follower filled. Rejected leader SL -> every follower locked with the unprotected-lot count. Lucid disconnect -> 5 Lucid accounts locked in under 1 s. Unlock refused while a daily-loss breach persisted. Offline: many cases + mutants.

Earlier: 1 lot + copied stop kept through a disconnect.

items.zh: 真 NT 跑 10-30 個帳戶（延遲、介面）
items.evidence: Real NT 2026-10-14: 1 Simulator leader + 11 prop-firm sim followers (5 Lucid, 6 Tradeify) on MNQ, Market + Limit + Stop, TP/SL OCO. Leader fill to follower Submit: all 11 within 6 ms of each other; follower fills 0.9-1.2 s after the leader fill (sim provider). Not measured: 20-30 accounts, multi-monitor DPI. Real NT 2026-10-15, source bfc8a2531acf: 10 prop-firm sim followers (4 Lucid, 6 Tradeify) MNQ Buy 1 / Sell 1 round trip, every follower exactly 2 orders (entry + exit), all filled, 0 open positions / orders afterwards. 2026-10-17: label narrowed to what was run (10-11 followers); the level stays 3 for the measured scope, 20-30 accounts remain listed as not proved (README limits).

items.en: Per-account daily target and daily loss limit with one-click OFF
items.zh: 每戶每日目標／虧損上限、一鍵 OFF
items.evidence: Real NT 2026-10-14: DLL 5 on one Tradeify follower latched 'Daily loss' (Start refused for it, others unaffected); unlock refused while the loss persisted; after DLL was set back to 0 the unlock went through. Daily TARGET latch is offline-only (P/L never reached +5 during the test). Real NT 2026-10-15, source bfc8a2531acf: the daily TARGET latch fired on a Lucid sim follower ('Target hit'); with the new opt-in 'Flat at limit' (Tgt 5 / DLL 5) a 1-lot MNQ copy hit 'Daily loss' 4 s after entry, exactly one Flatten request was sent, flat confirmed 4 s later, the leader's later exit was ignored (nothing to close), never retried. Unlock refused while the limit still applied, accepted after Tgt/DLL were set to 0.
